highlightNeighborsOnHover.description:
Configuration to control if 1st degree neighbors of a graph item (node or edge) should be highlighted
when they are hovered on.

title:
The configuration to control the behavior of hovered items. The appearance of the items can be configured in
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeStyleConfig} and {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationEdgeStyleConfig}.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationHoverConfig
